extracted.title: Kushavarta Tirtha reported closed to devotees until 31 October 2026
extracted.summary: Kushavarta Tirtha, the sacred tank at Trimbakeshwar, is reported to be closed to devotees until 31 October 2026 while renovation and development works for the Simhastha are completed. Alternative ritual locations were reported, including the Ahilya–Godavari Sangam ghat and several temples in the town.
